# Install `library` — Library — resource hub (prompts · visuals · snippets · links)

> Grab-bag resource hub.

📚 Knowledge base : https://resource.rahmanef.com/llms.txt
📦 Slice detail   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/slices/library
🧠 JSON catalog   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/api/knowledge?slice=library
🤖 Prompt page    : https://resource.rahmanef.com/agents/library

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add library
# alias: npx rr add library
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `library`, `resources`, `prompts`, `snippets`, `moodboard`, `downloads`, `attribution`, `seo`, `personal-brand`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add seo` (peer) then `npx rr add library`. Spread `seoTables` + `libraryTables` into your root Convex schema. Wrap the unauthenticated CRUD `internalMutation`s with your auth model (see README Install). Render `<LibraryIndex items={await fetchQuery(api.library.listPublic)} />` and `<LibraryDetail item={await fetchQuery(api.library.getBySlug, { slug })} />`. Pass `onUpvote` to enable voting (consumer-owned backend); override `copy` + `kindLabels` per consumer.

## Rules of engagement

- shadcn-only UI primitives. No raw `<button>` / `<dialog>` / native date or file inputs.
- 200-line hard cap per source file (extract neighbours when over).
- All Convex queries hit an index (`.withIndex(...)`); never bare `.collect()`.
- Public mutations/queries declare `args:` validators + authz.
- Full ruleset: https://resource.rahmanef.com/best-practice
